comments.author: Caddy
comments.body:
These are made inside atlantis dungeon via Casting; there are some hidden rooms where the recipe exists at a statue. Can't remember the level recipe requirement, but the base stats are 80att 20def and I think it's +2 guard and +1 something else (tactics?). On the last server I made a Great Success one which was 100att 35def, which is not too bad for a player-made weapon. I know that pure iron sheets and I think marble are some of the materials used in making them. Many of the materials for making these can be found inside the very dungeon they are created in.

I'll make a few later this week when Atlantis returns and post more info at that point, unless anyone else has that knowledge off-hand and would like to do so.

comments.author: Blake.C
comments.body: It requires R15 Casting and gives +2 to both Guard and Sword Mastery. Your need 60 Marble, 50 Silver, and 30 Pure Iron Sheet to make it. :)

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
In honor of Atlantis' brief return, a further tip: the Terra Amina weapon can also be upgraded via Transmutation Alchemy (with R13 Casting/Alchemy each and the usual Orichalcum/SPB ingredients) to create an entirely different weapon: Apotolos Amina

It's effectively the same stats as a baseline Terra Amina (recall TA will reset any Great Success buffs) but with a very unique EX effect: R12 Increase Relic Clue acquisition

The Apotolos Amina is the only piece of equipment in the game that gives such a high Relic Clue acquisition boost. Judge for yourselves if it's worth the investment required to make it; I know I always planned to have one made back on GAMA. Those were they days... well, time to make like Atlantis and vanish once more. Cheers.

Source: maitanblog2014.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-225.html (stats/pics), gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Skill/Product/Alchemy/ItemBoost (EX effect EQ table)
